def average(xs):
    return sum(xs) / len(xs) if len(xs) > 0 else 0

def top_students(scores, n):
    """scores is {name: marks}. Return the names of the n best students."""
    ranked = sorted(scores, key=lambda name: -scores[name])
    return ranked[:n]

def count_word(text, word):
    return sum(1 for w in text.lower().split() if w.strip(",.?").startswith(word.lower()))

from datetime import datetime

def days_between(a, b):
    a = datetime.strptime(a, "%Y-%m-%d")
    b = datetime.strptime(b, "%Y-%m-%d")
    return (b - a).days
